title: #490 - ’Ariel Phenomenon’ director Randall Nickerson | Matt's Movie Reviews Podcast
description:
Director Randall Nickerson joins Matthew Pejkovic on the Matt's Movie Reviews Podcast to talk about his new film 'Ariel Phenomenon', a documentary that delves into the 1994 mass UFO sighting event at the Ariel school in Zimbabwe, in which over 60 school children witnessed an extraterrestrial event. The film also explores the efforts of Harvard professor of psychiatry John Mack, and BBC war journalist Tim Leech, in keeping this story alive.
